correctness.rationale: The exact 5-adic factorial recursion yields an explicit 64-state digit transducer; exhaustive verify.py checks all 64x64 entries of its fourth transition power are between 4 and 16 and every column has five incoming transitions. Full factorials through n=500 and 59,988 direct triples agree. Computations certify only finite matrix facts; symbolic recurrence and mixing prove the infinite theorem.
